repair_notes.local_mathematics: For any C1 periodic pressure, the spatial derivative of its convolution equals convolution of the derivative: on a compact parameter neighborhood the difference quotients converge uniformly by uniform continuity of the first derivative. Integration against the integrable fixed kernel preserves this limit. Time differentiation is identical. Constant rho0 commutes with the integral. This directly verifies the regularity used in the repaired formulation; it does not incorrectly apply the Cinfinity-field commutation lemma to a merely C1 pressure.
